change: Fill hazard is an active raw or LOAD request for the same bank, independently of complete read validation.
read_guards: Ownership, epoch, full status, aperture and shape validation remain unchanged before every read.
valid_schedule_contract: No behavior, payload, status, or cycle change for valid schedules, including opposite-bank simultaneous fills and reads, raw delivery, final releases and bank reuse.
invalid_schedule_contract: A malformed conflicting raw or LOAD request can reject a same-bank fill that the baseline accepted before latching fault. Fill counters, seen bits, full flags and pcbad side effects after fault may differ. Sticky fault suppresses valid raw/converted outputs; reset is required. No invalid SRAM read is enabled.
required_checks: Full independent six-format/tail/offset golden checks on both banks
Raw NPC2/NPC4 lockstep and bank reuse
Exact fb912 valid-schedule differential replay: opposite-bank fills plus six-format LOADs or full raw drains across eight images
Malformed same-bank LOAD and raw-start conflicts: sticky faults, zero reads and zero valid outputs
Exact real producer replay and mapped native32 admission before physical successor
